name: cboxdk/cms
description: Cbox CMS: the kernel and the first-party modules in one package, with the contracts, core, HTTP and CLI surfaces, the generators and the testkit as namespaces.

suggest.driftingly/rector-laravel: Required by the testkit's shared Rector configuration (packages/testkit/config/rector.php); install it with require-dev.
suggest.larastan/larastan: Required by the testkit's shared PHPStan configuration (packages/testkit/config/phpstan.neon); install it with require-dev.
suggest.laravel/pint: Required by the testkit's shared Pint configuration (packages/testkit/config/pint.json); install it with require-dev.
suggest.opis/json-schema: Required by cms:generate, which validates blueprints against blueprint.v1.json; install it with require-dev.
suggest.orchestra/testbench: Required by the testkit's harnesses and fakes for tests; install it with require-dev.
suggest.phpstan/phpstan: Required by the testkit's PHPStan rules and shared configuration; install it with require-dev.
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Required by the testkit's shared contract suites; install it with require-dev.
suggest.rector/rector: Required by the testkit's shared Rector configuration; install it with require-dev.
suggest.symfony/yaml: Required by cms:generate, which reads the blueprint files; install it with require-dev.

check:generated:committed: git diff --exit-code -- workbench/app/Cms/Generated workbench/resources/js/cms/generated || { echo 'The generated code above is not the committed code. Generated code changes only through its schema: edit the blueprints in workbench/schema, run cms:generate and commit both.' >&2; exit 1; }

git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- workbench/app/Cms/Generated workbench/resources/js/cms/generated | awk '{ print "Untracked generated file: " $0; n++ } END { if (n > 0) print "Commit what cms:generate writes, and remove files it did not write."; exit n > 0 }'

scripts-descriptions.clear: Reset the Testbench application skeleton in vendor/.
scripts-descriptions.prepare: Discover the packages' service providers for the Testbench application.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the Pest suites of cboxdk/cms: the repository's tests and every module's.
scripts-descriptions.services:up: Start PHP 8.5 as the host user, Postgres 18 and Valkey 8 from the main checkout's compose.yaml and wait until they are healthy, then run the idempotent init script again, so an existing data volume gets the current roles and databases. From a linked worktree it starts only Postgres and Valkey, never recreates a container and says that the php container mounts the main checkout. Runs tools/bin/services.php.
scripts-descriptions.services:down: Stop the services from the main checkout's compose.yaml; the data volumes are kept. Refuses with exit 1 in a linked worktree, because the services are shared. Runs tools/bin/services.php.
scripts-descriptions.dev:prepare: Ready the workbench's dev database for cms:doctor, after `composer services:up`, from the main checkout: run the migrations as the owner role on pgsql_owner (cbox-cms.database.owner_connection), create the partition runway with cms:partitions:maintain on that connection, and build the registry cache with cms:build. Every step is idempotent; the script stops at a failing step and exits with its code.
scripts-descriptions.test-db:prune: Drop the Postgres test databases of removed checkouts: those named <configured database>_<12 hex digits> whose testkit comment names this host and a checkout path that no longer exists or no longer derives the name, with DROP DATABASE ... WITH (FORCE). Keeps the configured database, this checkout's, other hosts' and those without a valid comment, and prints each name with its verdict and reason. Option after --: --dry-run drops nothing. Runs tools/bin/prune-test-databases.php.
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Gate 10 of GUARDRAILS 10: fail with exit 1 when a public extension point of packages/*/src or packages/*/resources/schemas has no page with a running example, a page, marker, embedded example or file below examples/ breaks the rules of Cbox\Cms\Tooling\Docs\Domain\DocsAudit (GUARDRAILS 2.4, PRD 14.4), docs/ breaks the layout of the cboxdk docs standard (only index.md, quickstart.md and requirements.md at its root, an _index.md in every folder, title, weight and description frontmatter on every page, no Markdown below packages/), a relative link in docs/ or README.md dangles, or the screenshots in docs/screenshots do not match Cbox\Cms\Tooling\Docs\Domain\Screenshots. Prints each finding as <file>:<line>: <message> or <subject>: <message>. Option after --: --root=<dir> checks another tree. Runs tools/bin/docs-check.php.
scripts-descriptions.docs:requirements: Write docs/requirements.md from cboxdk/cms's composer.json, package.json and compose.yaml with Cbox\Cms\Tooling\Docs\Domain\RequirementsPage: PHP, Laravel, the PHP extensions and the other platform requirements, every package of require and every package of suggest with its reason, as the resolver enforces them; Node from engines in package.json and the image of each service of compose.yaml for development; and the minimums cms:doctor checks at run time. Writes only when the bytes differ, so a second run changes nothing; a test in tests/Feature/Tooling/Docs fails when the page differs from what it writes. Option after --: --root=<dir> writes the page of another tree. Runs tools/bin/docs-requirements.php.
scripts-descriptions.docs:screenshots: Capture the screenshots of the documentation: run each command of Cbox\Cms\Tooling\Docs\Domain\Screenshots from the repository root with colour on and draw its output as a terminal in docs/screenshots/<key>.svg. A command whose output depends on the clock, the machine or the services runs in a scene through tools/bin/docs-scene.php, with a fixed clock and fake doctor probes, so it needs no services and a second capture changes nothing. Exits 1 when a command ends with another exit code than its entry expects, and writes nothing for that shot. Option after --: --only=<key>, repeatable. Runs tools/bin/docs-screenshots.php.
scripts-descriptions.install:check: The first step of gate 5: fail with exit 1 when vendor/ is not the installation composer.lock and composer.json describe, because a package differs from composer.lock by name, version or reference, or a PSR-4, PSR-0 or files rule of the root package's autoload or autoload-dev differs from the dumped autoloader in vendor/composer (Cbox\Cms\Tooling\Install\Domain\InstallAudit). A checkout that moved without composer install, such as the main checkout after the merge queue fast-forwards it, fails here with the fix instead of failing a suite at load with Class not found. Prints each difference. Option after --: --root=<dir> checks another checkout. Runs tools/bin/install-check.php.
scripts-descriptions.progress:check: Fail unless PROGRESS.md and CHECKS-LOG.md record a task before the merge queue moves main: an entry for it under Kontroller kørt in PROGRESS.md, with --changed-checks also one in CHECKS-LOG.md under the heading of its block that says GUARDRAILS 7.3, and with --range=<range> no commit of the range that changes no file. Arguments after --: <block>-<task> [--changed-checks] [--range=main..HEAD]. Runs tools/bin/progress-check.php.
scripts-descriptions.progress:test: Run the tests that read PROGRESS.md, CHECKS-LOG.md and this checkout's history of review commits, all in tests/Feature/Tooling/Progress, on the working tree and HEAD. The merge queue runs it on the progress commit it writes after composer check, and moves main only when it passes, because composer check ran before that commit existed. Fails when a test fails, is skipped or incomplete, or none ran.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Format the PHP code with Pint and the shared configuration from the testkit.
scripts-descriptions.lint:check: Gate 1: fail if Pint would change any file.
scripts-descriptions.rector: Apply the shared Rector sets from the testkit.
scripts-descriptions.rector:check: Gate 2: fail if Rector would change any file.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Gate 3: PHPStan level 10 with Larastan over the packages, the tests and the workbench, without a baseline.
scripts-descriptions.check: The local profile of GUARDRAILS 10: gates 1 to 6 in order, each marked pass, fail or not run. Exits 1 when a gate fails. Gate 5 needs `composer services:up`. Options after --: --report=<file> writes a JSON report, --brief leaves failed output out of the console.
scripts-descriptions.check:selftest: Plant one known violation per gate in a temporary git worktree of HEAD, run composer check there, and fail unless each gate catches its violation with a path inside the worktree. Removes the worktree afterwards.
scripts-descriptions.check:generated: Gate 6: regenerate the workbench's code from its fixture schema and fail if the generated code differs from the committed code, before or after, or a generated file is untracked (PRD 11.12).
scripts-descriptions.check:generated:committed: Fail if the workbench's generated code has unstaged changes or untracked files.
